# kkp_machine_deployment (Resource)

A machine deployment: a group of worker nodes of a cluster. KKP refuses machine deployments until the cluster's control plane is healthy, so the provider retries creation until then. Changing the node template (image, flavor, operating system, labels, kubelet version, …) makes machine-controller replace the nodes one by one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kkp_machine_deployment" "workers" {
  cluster_id       = kkp_cluster.staging.id
  name             = "workers"
  replicas         = 3
  min_replicas     = 1
  max_replicas     = 6
  operating_system = "ubuntu"

  node_labels = { pool = "general" }
  taints      = [{ key = "dedicated", value = "batch", effect = "NoSchedule" }]

  openstack = {
    flavor    = "m1.large"
    image     = "Ubuntu 24.04"
    disk_size = 50
  }
}

resource "kkp_machine_deployment" "aws_spot" {
  cluster_id       = kkp_cluster.aws.id
  name             = "spot"
  replicas         = 2
  operating_system = "amzn2"

  aws = {
    instance_type    = "t3.large"
    disk_size        = 50
    volume_type      = "gp3"
    is_spot_instance = true
  }
}

resource "kkp_machine_deployment" "hetzner" {
  cluster_id       = kkp_cluster.hetzner.id
  name             = "workers"
  replicas         = 3
  operating_system = "ubuntu"
  hetzner          = { type = "cx32" }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID (`kkp_cluster.id`).
- `name` (String) Name, a DNS label.
- `operating_system` (String) `ubuntu`, `flatcar`, `rhel`, `rockylinux` or `amzn2` (Amazon Linux 2, AWS only).
- `replicas` (Number) Number of nodes.

### Optional

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS machine settings, matching the cluster's cloud provider. Set the block of the datacenter's cloud provider, and only that one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `azure` (Attributes) Azure machine settings, matching the cluster's cloud provider. Set the block of the datacenter's cloud provider, and only that one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure))
- `digitalocean` (Attributes) DigitalOcean machine settings, matching the cluster's cloud provider. Set the block of the datacenter's cloud provider, and only that one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--digitalocean))
- `dist_upgrade_on_boot` (Boolean) Upgrade all packages on first boot (all but Flatcar).
- `flatcar_disable_auto_update` (Boolean) Disable Flatcar's automatic updates.
- `gcp` (Attributes) Google Cloud machine settings, matching the cluster's cloud provider. Set the block of the datacenter's cloud provider, and only that one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcp))
- `hetzner` (Attributes) Hetzner Cloud machine settings, matching the cluster's cloud provider. Set the block of the datacenter's cloud provider, and only that one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hetzner))
- `kubelet_version` (String) Kubelet version. Defaults to the cluster's version at creation; it must not be newer than the control plane, nor more than three minor versions older.
- `max_replicas` (Number) Upper bound for the cluster autoscaler.
- `min_replicas` (Number) Lower bound for the cluster autoscaler. Set together with `max_replicas`.
- `node_annotations` (Map of String) Kubernetes annotations for the nodes.
- `node_labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels for the nodes. The labels KKP adds (`system/cluster`, `system/project`) are ignored.
- `openstack` (Attributes) OpenStack machine settings, matching the cluster's cloud provider. Set the block of the datacenter's cloud provider, and only that one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--openstack))
- `operating_system_profile` (String) Operating System Manager profile. Defaults to the one for the OS, e.g. `osp-ubuntu`; a profile removed from the configuration stays until the OS changes.
- `paused` (Boolean) Pause rollouts of template changes.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Taints for the nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait until all replicas are available after create and update.

### Read-Only

- `available_replicas` (Number)
- `creation_timestamp` (String)
- `id` (String) Machine deployment ID (KKP uses the name).
- `ready_replicas` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `disk_size` (Number) Root volume size in GB.
- `instance_type` (String) EC2 instance type, e.g. `t3.large`.
- `volume_type` (String) EBS volume type, e.g. `gp3`.

Optional:

- `ami` (String) AMI. Defaults to the datacenter's image for the operating system.
- `assign_public_ip` (Boolean) Give the nodes public IPs.
- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone; must match `subnet_id`.
- `ebs_volume_encrypted` (Boolean) Encrypt the root volume.
- `is_spot_instance` (Boolean) Use spot instances.
- `spot_instance_interruption_behavior` (String) `terminate`, `stop` or `hibernate`.
- `spot_instance_max_price` (String) Maximum hourly spot price.
- `spot_instance_persistent_request` (Boolean) Keep the spot request open after an interruption.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet of the cluster's VPC.
- `tags` (Map of String) Extra instance tags. The tags KKP adds (`kubernetes.io/cluster/<id>`, `system/cluster`, `system/project`) are ignored.


<a id="nestedatt--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure`

Required:

- `size` (String) VM size, e.g. `Standard_D4s_v5`.

Optional:

- `assign_availability_set` (Boolean) Put the nodes into the cluster's availability set.
- `assign_public_ip` (Boolean) Give the nodes public IPs.
- `data_disk_size` (Number) Data disk size in GB.
- `enable_accelerated_networking` (Boolean) Enable accelerated networking.
- `image_id` (String) Image ID. Defaults to the datacenter's image for the operating system.
- `os_disk_size` (Number) OS disk size in GB.
- `tags` (Map of String) Extra VM tags. The tags KKP adds (`KubernetesCluster`, `system-cluster`, `system-project`) are ignored.
- `zones` (List of String) Availability zones, e.g. `["1", "2"]`.


<a id="nestedatt--digitalocean"></a>
### Nested Schema for `digitalocean`

Required:

- `size` (String) Droplet size slug, e.g. `s-4vcpu-8gb`.

Optional:

- `backups` (Boolean) Enable droplet backups.
- `monitoring` (Boolean) Enable droplet monitoring.
- `tags` (List of String) Extra droplet tags. The tags KKP adds (`kubernetes`, `kubernetes-cluster-<id>`, `system-cluster-<id>`, `system-project-<id>`) are ignored.


<a id="nestedatt--gcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcp`

Required:

- `disk_size` (Number) Boot disk size in GB.
- `disk_type` (String) Boot disk type, e.g. `pd-balanced`.
- `machine_type` (String) Machine type, e.g. `e2-standard-4`.

Optional:

- `custom_image` (String) Custom image instead of the operating system's default.
- `labels` (Map of String) GCE labels.
- `preemptible` (Boolean) Use preemptible VMs.
- `tags` (List of String) GCE network tags. The tags KKP adds (`kubernetes-cluster-<id>`, `system-cluster-<id>`, `system-project-<id>`) are ignored.
- `zone` (String) Zone, e.g. `europe-west3-a`. Defaults to a zone of the datacenter.


<a id="nestedatt--hetzner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hetzner`

Required:

- `type` (String) Server type, e.g. `cx32`.

Optional:

- `network` (String) Network. Defaults to the cluster's.


<a id="nestedatt--openstack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `openstack`

Required:

- `flavor` (String) Flavor name.
- `image` (String) Image name or ID. The datacenter's default images are listed by `kkp_datacenter`.

Optional:

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone. Defaults to the datacenter's.
- `config_drive` (Boolean) Use a config drive instead of the metadata service.
- `disk_size` (Number) Root volume size in GB. Unset uses the flavor's local disk.
- `instance_ready_check_period` (String) How often machine-controller checks a new instance, e.g. `5s`.
- `instance_ready_check_timeout` (String) How long machine-controller waits for a new instance, e.g. `2m`.
- `server_group` (String) Server group ID, e.g. for anti-affinity.
- `tags` (Map of String) OpenStack server tags (metadata). The tags KKP adds (`kubernetes-cluster`, `system-cluster`, `system-project`) are ignored.
- `use_floating_ip` (Boolean) Give every node a floating IP.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import kkp_machine_deployment.workers <project_id>/<cluster_id>/<machine_deployment_name>
```
